card.title: Longest Run With At Most k Letters

a1.cap: Return the length of the longest substring of s that contains at most k distinct characters.

lines: Return the length of the longest substring of s that contains at most k distinct characters.

a1.cap: For example, with s = "eceba", k = 2, the answer is 3. "ece".
a1.say: For example, with s equals "eceba", k equals 2, the answer is 3. "ece".

a1.cap: Add s[right] to the counts. While more than k distinct characters are inside, shrink from the left until one of them disappears. Track the longest valid window.
a1.say: Add s at right to the counts. While more than k distinct characters are inside, shrink from the left until one of them disappears. Track the longest valid window.
